title: Control plane kind: flow dir: down
[Clients] gray right cli: funcdctl sdk: SDK | pkg/sdk http: HTTP | any client [/]
[Control plane] teal right api: API | token, RBAC, admission ctrl: Controller | a reconciler per kind [/]
[Storage layer] coral meta: Metastore @db [/]
dp: Data plane | routes, workers, stores @blue
Clients > api api > meta: writes ctrl <> meta: watch, status ctrl > dp
